
{{alias}}( [options] )
    Returns a padding instance.

    Parameters
    ----------
    options: Object (optional)
        Options.

    options.bottom: number (optional)
        Bottom padding (in pixels). Default: 0.

    options.left: number (optional)
        Left padding (in pixels). Default: 0.

    options.right: number (optional)
        Right padding (in pixels). Default: 0.

    options.top: number (optional)
        Top padding (in pixels). Default: 0.

    Returns
    -------
    padding: Padding
        Padding instance.

    padding.bottom
        Bottom padding (in pixels).

    padding.left
        Left padding (in pixels).

    padding.properties
        List of enumerable properties.

    padding.right
        Right padding (in pixels).

    padding.top
        Top padding (in pixels).

    padding.toJSON()
        Serializes a padding instance to a JSON object.

    Examples
    --------
    > var padding = new {{alias}}()
    <Padding>

    // Provide options at instantiation:
    > padding = new {{alias}}( { 'top': 10, 'bottom': 20 } )
    <Padding>
    > padding.top
    10

    // Set a property:
    > padding.left = 30;
    > padding.left
    30

    // Serialize to JSON:
    > padding.toJSON()
    { 'bottom': 20, 'left': 30, 'right': 0, 'top': 10 }

    --------
